dnd.cancelled: Moving cancelled. {{name}} is back in place.

banner.waking: Waking up the server. The free hosting plan sleeps when idle, so this can take up to a minute.
banner.offline: We can't reach the server right now.
banner.deviceOffline: You're offline. You can keep adding expenses: they're sent when you're back online.
banner.update: A new version of the app is ready.

auth.name: Your name

login.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask your administrator for a one-time password.

register.title: Create your account
register.closed: Registration is closed. Ask your administrator for an account.

change.title: Change password
change.forcedBody: Your password was reset. Enter the one-time password you received, then choose your own.
change.setBody: Your account signs in with Google. To add a password, sign in with Google again to confirm it's you.

rules.title: Your password needs
rules.too_simple: At least {{count}} kinds of characters (lowercase, uppercase, digits, symbols)
rules.surrounding_whitespace: No spaces at the start or end
rules.same_as_current: Something different from your current password

auth.lockedFor: Too many attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} min.

twoFactor.title: Two-step sign-in
twoFactor.prompt: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.recoveryHint: Lost your phone? Enter one of your recovery codes instead.

security.title: Security
security.confirmEverywhere: Sign out of every device, including this one?
security.empty: No other devices are signed in.

twoFactor.title: Two-step sign-in
twoFactor.unavailable: Two-step sign-in isn't available on this server yet.
twoFactor.explain: Each time you sign in, also enter a code from an authenticator app on your phone, so a stolen password alone can't get in.
twoFactor.scan: Add this account to your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, 2FAS or any TOTP app).
twoFactor.typeKey: Or type this key into the app:
twoFactor.enterCode: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
twoFactor.codesOnce: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your phone. They won't be shown again.
twoFactor.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Download the codes or write them down instead.

data.title: Your data
data.exportExplain: Download everything the app keeps about you as one JSON file.
data.deleteExplain: Delete your account and everything in it. This can't be undone.
data.deleteWarning: Everything you've added, your settings and your devices will be erased for good. Export your data first if you want a copy.

reauth.googleAgain: Sign in with Google again to confirm it's you.
reauth.noGoogle: Google sign-in isn't available right now, so this can't be confirmed. An admin can reset your password.

module.unavailableBody: It's turned off or hasn't launched yet.

palette.title: Command palette
palette.placeholder: Search pages, modules and settings, or ask…

dashboard.subtitle: Your numbers at a glance
dashboard.allUsersHint: Totals across every user, with no individual records
dashboard.widgetFailed: Couldn't load this one. The rest is up to date.

reason.no_provider: AI isn't set up on this server.
reason.providers_failed: The AI service isn't answering right now.
reason.no_static: This needs AI, which is switched off.

agents.enableHint: Your request goes to a free AI service. Email addresses and long numbers are masked first, and nothing changes until you confirm it.

static.no_match: I can't do that without AI. Try “pin journal” or “open receipts”.

manage-modules.no-module: I couldn't tell which module you mean.

ready.pin: Confirm to add {{name}} to your favourites.
ready.unpin: Confirm to remove {{name}} from your favourites.
ready.notify: Confirm and we'll tell you when {{name}} launches.
ready.stop-notify: Confirm to stop the launch notice for {{name}}.

check-notifications.none-unread: Nothing new. You're all caught up.

ready.show_zero: Nothing unread. Here are your notifications.
ready.mark-read_one: Confirm to mark {{count}} notification as read.
ready.mark-read_other: Confirm to mark {{count}} notifications as read.

usage.fallbackRate: Answered by rules instead of AI

user.oneTime: One-time password: give it to them privately. It is shown only now; they must choose a new password when they sign in.
user.self: This is your own account. Change it from your Security page.
user.disableBody: They're signed out everywhere and can't sign in until you enable the account again. Nothing is deleted.
user.revokeBody: Every device they're signed in on has to sign in again.
user.resetBody: You'll get a one-time password to give them. Their devices are signed out and two-step sign-in is turned off, so they can get back in.
user.roleBody: Every device they're signed in on has to sign in again. The change is kept in the audit log.

mode.open: Registration is open to anyone right now, so this list isn't used until it's switched to invitation only.
mode.closed: Registration is closed right now, so nobody can register, even from this list.

allowlist.none: Nobody is on the list yet.

modules.explain: Changes here apply to everyone. Reset puts a module back to how it ships.
modules.resetHint: Back to the module's own settings

pwa.install: Install the app on this device

outbox.waiting_one: {{count}} thing you added offline is waiting to be sent.
outbox.waiting_other: {{count}} things you added offline are waiting to be sent.

unsaved.title: Leave without saving?
unsaved.body: What you entered here isn't saved yet. If you leave now, it will be lost.

push.title: Reminders on this device
push.explain: Get reminders here even when the app is closed. Each device is turned on by itself.
push.dismissed: Notifications weren't allowed yet. Press “Turn on” to be asked again.
push.noWorker: This browser isn't ready for notifications yet. Reload the page, then try again.
push.testSent_zero: No device could be reached. Try again later.
push.unsupported: This browser can't show the app's notifications. On iPhone or iPad, add the app to the Home Screen and open it from there.
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser's site settings, then come back here.
push.fallback: You have a new notification. Open the app to see it.

uiMode.simple: Simple mode: larger text, fewer fields
uiMode.turnOn: Turn on Simple mode (larger text, fewer fields)
uiMode.notSaved: Couldn't save the Simple mode change. Check your connection and try again.

speak.title: What would you like to do?
speak.error: Couldn't hear that. Tap the microphone to try again, or type it below.
speak.blocked: The microphone isn't allowed for this site. Type it in the box below instead.
speak.listening: Listening… say it in your own words.
speak.hint: Tap the microphone and say it, like “250 rupees for vegetables”.
speak.typeOnly: Type it below, like “250 rupees for vegetables”.

home.title: Welcome! This is your home
home.body: Each tile is a module. Open one to use it, or star it to keep it first. Hide the ones you don't need.

palette.title: Find anything, or just ask
palette.body: Press Ctrl+K (or the search button at the top) to jump to any page, or ask the assistant in your own words, in English, Tamil or Hindi.

voice.title: Say it, and it's tracked
voice.body: On Expenses, say or type what you spent, like “250 for vegetables”. You check it before it's saved. Without a connection, it waits on your phone.

reminders.title: Reminders that find you
reminders.body: The bell shows what's due. Under Notifications you can also get reminders on this device when the app is closed.

yours.title: Make it yours
yours.body: At the top: language, theme, and Simple mode for larger text and fewer fields. Security keeps your account safe and lets you download or delete your data.
